summary.en: Two dimensions of relating in close relationships, anxiety and avoidance, measured by questionnaire; categories are derived only with a stated rule.
summary.ru: Два измерения отношений в близких связях — тревожность и избегание; измеряются опросником; категории выводятся только по явно указанному правилу.

mentalModel.summary: People differ in how much they worry about closeness and how much they keep distance; both are continuous dimensions.
assumptions: dimensions are more precise than categories
results depend on the relationship target asked about
results describe the person, never the other person in the relationship
mentalModel.unitOfAnalysis: the person's way of relating in close relationships
attendsTo: what the person watches for in closeness
the relationship target the result refers to
mentalModel.languageGuidance: Speak of tendencies in relating, never of attachment disorders; never describe a partner or anyone else.

dont: describe the other person in a relationship

exploratoryQuestions: In close relationships, what do you tend to watch for?
helperMustNot: describe a partner's or any other person's attachment (TP-1)
present a category as a diagnosis
use results in any work context
riskNotes: Intimate-relationship data can indirectly reveal sex life or health

toolkit.name: Record a questionnaire result
toolkit.description: Record the two ECR-R dimension scores with the relationship target; a category only as derived, with the rule.

representations.description: A plot of anxiety against avoidance; a category is shown only as derived, with its rule (AR-6).

suggestionRequires: the person asked for ways of looking at close relationships

citations.note: Fraley, Waller & Brennan 2000: item response theory analysis of self-report attachment measures

citations.ref: R. Chris Fraley, ECR-R measure page
citations.note: Classifying people by their scores reduces the precision of measurement

supports: self-reflection on how the person relates in closeness
language the person chose for it
